`final class Task`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.task` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Task.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/task/Task.java)

Code that runs once after a delay, or on a period, while it is attached to a UI or a node.

## Description

A task counts its delay from the moment it is attached, and runs on the render thread when its UI starts to draw, on the first frame after it is due (after the update step).
A task attached to a node runs while the node belongs to an open UI; a one-shot task detaches itself when it runs.
A task attached in the constructor of a UI comes back at every opening; one attached in `init()` lasts until the UI closes.

<a id="Task-method-owner"></a>

### owner

`this owner(UI ui, Node node)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Records the owner of the task and, when it has one, starts counting its delay.
`UI.addTask` and `Node.addTask` call it; you attach with `attach`.

<a id="Task-method-fireRun"></a>

### fireRun

`void fireRun()` 

Runs the listeners now and plans the next run, or detaches a one-shot task.
The UI calls it when the task is due.
